'''Yuna Ogata''' (Japanese: '''緒方佑奈''' ''Ogata Yūna'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Ogata was born on July 31 in Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan and became a voice actress as an adult. Ogata first worked on Pokémon voicing {{ga|Gloria}} in [[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]] before joining the {{pkmn|animated series}} voicing minor recurring character [[Vic]]. She gained her most notable role during {{aniseries|HZ}} when she voiced [[Liko]]'s classmate [[Ann]]. Ogata is currently affiliated with {{wp|I'm Enterprise}}.
